scope: Non-biological presentation review of four Best Model winners from 2023–2025. No biological literature, constructs, datasets, parameter transfer or optimization is included.
method: Read the model pages and their rendered article structure; verify award status separately against university reports. This is a presentation audit, not an independent reproduction or validation of the teams' research.

awardVerification.publisher: Peking University Center for Quantitative Biology
awardVerification.finding: The university report explicitly lists Best Model as a win (Top 1), distinct from nominations.

reviews.organization: A contents-led, continuous research article repeats background, assumptions, mathematical formulation, computational method and results across modules.
reviews.figuresAndEquations: Numbered equations, nearby symbol definitions and parameter tables support numbered figures with explanatory captions. Workflow diagrams introduce computational stages before detailed plots.
reviews.codeAndReferences: Data-source and parameter-source subsections make provenance visible. Numbered citations accompany the argument; a separate code repository is organized by model module.
reviews.validationPresentation: Methods, computational checks, results and later interpretation occupy identifiable subsections; readers can trace a claim back to the relevant setup. These observations do not establish that every reported result has external validation.
reviews.reusableLesson: Repeat one compact scientific reading pattern across modules, with locally defined quantities and sources rather than an isolated reference dump.

awardVerification.publisher: Heidelberg University, Institute of Pharmacy and Molecular Biotechnology
awardVerification.finding: The university report explicitly includes Best Model among the team's awards.

reviews.organization: A concise overview introduces the framework, followed by assumptions, methods, implementation, results, discussion and references. Navigation supports a long article rather than fragmenting it into disconnected cards.
reviews.figuresAndEquations: Lettered multi-panel figures receive panel-specific captions. Parameter sections sit near implementation details; collapsible method panels reduce visual load without replacing the main explanation.
reviews.codeAndReferences: A dedicated user-manual and implementation section separates execution instructions from scientific interpretation. A full reference list follows the discussion.
reviews.validationPresentation: Prediction-versus-measurement comparisons appear within the results narrative, alongside alternative conditions and a discussion of how the comparison affected later work.
reviews.reusableLesson: Place the comparison plot beside the claim it tests. Keep enough static explanation visible for the article to remain understandable without opening every detail panel.

awardVerification.publisher: Zhejiang University Biology Experimental Teaching Center
awardVerification.finding: The university report explicitly lists Best Model among the team's awards.

reviews.organization: Nested contents introduce numbered modules and subsections. A workflow figure precedes derivations; an appendix holds additional detail.
reviews.figuresAndEquations: Numbered equations are accompanied by local definitions. Observation tables, fitted-parameter tables and comparison plots are placed within the same analytical sequence. Figures have sequential identifiers and captions.
reviews.codeAndReferences: References and derivation appendices are available. No clearly labeled executable-code download was identified on the inspected main model page; this is not a claim that none exists elsewhere.
reviews.validationPresentation: The narrative compares fitted curves with observations and explicitly notes an interval beyond which the approximation loses agreement. Later comparison sections link back to the model development.
reviews.reusableLesson: Show the valid range of a fit and its discrepancies, not only the best-looking result. Separate observed values, fitted parameters and predictions visually.

awardVerification.finding: The report explicitly identifies the 2024 Best Model win and shows the award. The correct wiki slug is utoronto.

reviews.organization: A paper-like sequence runs from abstract, background and objectives through methods, batch-by-batch results, discussion, limitations, next steps and references.
reviews.figuresAndEquations: Workflow illustrations and distributions support each results batch. An appendix groups architecture, hyperparameters, hardware and evaluation definitions; tables carry implementation details. The page does not force a long equation sequence where a workflow explanation is clearer.
reviews.codeAndReferences: A separate Software page and the wiki GitLab repository are linked. Numbered references support the main text, with further references in the appendix.
reviews.validationPresentation: The article explicitly distinguishes failed early tests, promising later tests and work still awaiting completion. Discussion connects each revision with feedback, making the iteration visible.
reviews.reusableLesson: Report successive attempts and unresolved checks honestly. Keep computational evaluation, completed experimental checks and planned work as separate evidence categories.

recommendedArticlePattern: Open with the research question, a compact overview figure and a navigable contents list.
For each module, use a continuous question → assumptions → equations or workflow → parameters and provenance → results → checks → interpretation sequence.
Define each symbol and unit next to its first equation. State whether values are measured, sourced, fitted or illustrative.
Give figures stable numbers and lettered panels where useful. Captions should state what is shown, conditions, provenance and the narrow conclusion supported.
Pair results with an explicit comparison or diagnostic. State the range tested and any disagreement; use verification, calibration and validation precisely.
Keep negative and unfinished results visible with their correct status. A planned check must not appear as a completed validation.
Put runnable scripts, input descriptions, environment information and figure-data downloads near the corresponding methods; retain a consolidated reproducibility index.
Use optional expanders for lengthy derivations and implementation detail. The central scientific argument should remain readable without interacting with controls.
Close with limitations and the next measurements needed, followed by complete linked references. Cite sources at the claim as well as in the bibliography.
boundaries: An award verifies recognition by the competition, not independent correctness of every claim on a wiki.
Borrow presentation principles, not text, artwork, numerical results or biological models.
This review does not determine which equations or methods were originally invented by the teams; attribution must be checked individually.
The four pages were read, but their software and research were not independently reproduced.
These presentation practices do not guarantee publication, performance or an award.
